title: Big Four takes Lakers back to No. 1
heading: 2003-04 Power Rankings: Week 22

rankings.summaryHtml: OK, maybe it's not solely Kobe. Lakers are 8-1 with Mailman back in the lineup ... and thus back to No. 1 for the first time in 14 weeks.
rankings.summaryText: OK, maybe it's not solely Kobe. Lakers are 8-1 with Mailman back in the lineup ... and thus back to No. 1 for the first time in 14 weeks.

rankings.summaryHtml: We'll say the same thing about Jermaine that we said about Kobe initially: Why not let JO sit a little longer? Especially with all the winning Indy has been doing without him.
rankings.summaryText: We'll say the same thing about Jermaine that we said about Kobe initially: Why not let JO sit a little longer? Especially with all the winning Indy has been doing without him.

rankings.summaryHtml: As Detroit discovered, Spurs are pretty unbeatable when they hold the opposition under 80. 22-0 now, in fact.
rankings.summaryText: As Detroit discovered, Spurs are pretty unbeatable when they hold the opposition under 80. 22-0 now, in fact.

rankings.summaryHtml: We're not going to lump in every Kings fan, but whoever's booing Webber is so far out of the line that the line is a dot to the boobirds. This guy put Sacramento on the NBA map, kept Kings there by staying there, and he doesn't get a grace period?
rankings.summaryText: We're not going to lump in every Kings fan, but whoever's booing Webber is so far out of the line that the line is a dot to the boobirds. This guy put Sacramento on the NBA map, kept Kings there by staying there, and he doesn't get a grace period?

rankings.summaryHtml: You want to hear something really scary? Grizz can still WIN the Midwest, with two games left against Minny and already holding the tiebreaker over Spurs.
rankings.summaryText: You want to hear something really scary? Grizz can still WIN the Midwest, with two games left against Minny and already holding the tiebreaker over Spurs.

rankings.summaryHtml: Team record for wins is 51. Of course, before this 7-8 slump, Wolves were on pace to win 60.
rankings.summaryText: Team record for wins is 51. Of course, before this 7-8 slump, Wolves were on pace to win 60.

rankings.summaryHtml: We go out on a limb for Pistons and look what we get? Two losses, and two hobbled Wallaces. Blame the supposed Power Rankings jinx all you want, but no one will have that crutch in the playoffs, when there are no Power Rankings.
rankings.summaryText: We go out on a limb for Pistons and look what we get? Two losses, and two hobbled Wallaces. Blame the supposed Power Rankings jinx all you want, but no one will have that crutch in the playoffs, when there are no Power Rankings.

rankings.summaryHtml: Jeff Van Gundy has never had a losing season as a coach. He avoided it this season in spite of Rockets' 18-24 record vs. West foes, the worst of any playoff team.
rankings.summaryText: Jeff Van Gundy has never had a losing season as a coach. He avoided it this season in spite of Rockets' 18-24 record vs. West foes, the worst of any playoff team.

rankings.summaryHtml: With Mavs' defense, you expect problems. But chemistry has never been a Mavs problem in this era. Until now, it seems.
rankings.summaryText: With Mavs' defense, you expect problems. But chemistry has never been a Mavs problem in this era. Until now, it seems.

rankings.summaryHtml: Committee knows it's not supposed to be rooting for one team over another ... but how can you not root for Jerry and the Jazz to make the Elite Eight?
rankings.summaryText: Committee knows it's not supposed to be rooting for one team over another ... but how can you not root for Jerry and the Jazz to make the Elite Eight?

rankings.summaryHtml: This ain't the East. No backing into a playoff spot in the West. Blazers, on a 7-2 run, only just moved into a tie for No. 8.
rankings.summaryText: This ain't the East. No backing into a playoff spot in the West. Blazers, on a 7-2 run, only just moved into a tie for No. 8.

rankings.summaryHtml: Forgive 'Melo for the 'quitter' incident. He can't do much more than he's doing to keep Denver in playoff hunt, having scored 25 points in all but four of 29 games in one recent stretch.
rankings.summaryText: Forgive 'Melo for the 'quitter' incident. He can't do much more than he's doing to keep Denver in playoff hunt, having scored 25 points in all but four of 29 games in one recent stretch.

rankings.summaryHtml: With all the good stories on this team -- Dwyane, Lamar, Stan -- too many of us have overlooked Rafer Alston. He'd actually prefer you don't call him Skip To My Lou these days, and he's giving us plenty of reasons not to.
rankings.summaryText: With all the good stories on this team -- Dwyane, Lamar, Stan -- too many of us have overlooked Rafer Alston. He'd actually prefer you don't call him Skip To My Lou these days, and he's giving us plenty of reasons not to.

rankings.summaryHtml: What would concern me now, if I were a Nets fan like our good friend and research ace Sanford Appell: Wearing out Jefferson while J-Kidd and K-Mart are recuperating.
rankings.summaryText: What would concern me now, if I were a Nets fan like our good friend and research ace Sanford Appell: Wearing out Jefferson while J-Kidd and K-Mart are recuperating.

rankings.summaryHtml: Seattle stretched its too-late win streak to seven games before finally losing to Portland. So we still have to hold off on the quips about that 6-2 start.
rankings.summaryText: Seattle stretched its too-late win streak to seven games before finally losing to Portland. So we still have to hold off on the quips about that 6-2 start.

rankings.summaryHtml: We were just kidding when we suggested Warriors should try to finish the season with 17 straight wins, but they're apparently going for it anyway. Muss might be in trouble, rightly or wrongly, but he can definitely coach.
rankings.summaryText: We were just kidding when we suggested Warriors should try to finish the season with 17 straight wins, but they're apparently going for it anyway. Muss might be in trouble, rightly or wrongly, but he can definitely coach.

rankings.summaryHtml: T.J. Ford might not even be back for the playoffs? Van Horn turns an ankle? One of the fairy tales of the season gets sadder by the day.
rankings.summaryText: T.J. Ford might not even be back for the playoffs? Van Horn turns an ankle? One of the fairy tales of the season gets sadder by the day.

rankings.summaryHtml: Pierce says: 'We're in, baby. We're in. Pencil us in.' Looking at Celts' remaining schedule, we can't really argue.
rankings.summaryText: Pierce says: 'We're in, baby. We're in. Pencil us in.' Looking at Celts' remaining schedule, we can't really argue.

rankings.summaryHtml: Credit where credit is due: Cavs are 17-9 when McInnis plays ... and 15-31 without him.
rankings.summaryText: Credit where credit is due: Cavs are 17-9 when McInnis plays ... and 15-31 without him.

rankings.summaryHtml: Yikes. Baron- and Mash-less Hornets have dropped eight straight on the road ... and play seven of their final nine games on the road.
rankings.summaryText: Yikes. Baron- and Mash-less Hornets have dropped eight straight on the road ... and play seven of their final nine games on the road.

rankings.summaryHtml: Houston and Tim Thomas injuries have definitely hurt, but If Celts are in -- as Pierce is promising -- it looks like this is the team on the slide that LeBron must knock out to get to the playoffs.
rankings.summaryText: Houston and Tim Thomas injuries have definitely hurt, but If Celts are in -- as Pierce is promising -- it looks like this is the team on the slide that LeBron must knock out to get to the playoffs.

rankings.summaryHtml: Does anyone else see Sixers' recent success with AI in street clothes as a message from the other players that they, too, want to sample life with AI in another city?

rankings.summaryHtml: Committee still likes Dice enough to say that a Dice-Amare-Marion front line sounds intriguing. Doesn't it?

rankings.summaryHtml: Vince scores 40 twice in one week ... and no one notices with both coach and GM in danger of losing their jobs.
rankings.summaryText: Vince scores 40 twice in one week ... and no one notices with both coach and GM in danger of losing their jobs.

rankings.summaryHtml: It ain't much consolation, but it's something: Hawks' single-season NBA record for defense (83.4 ppg allowed) looks safe, even with Pistons (84.6) and Spurs (84.9) challenging.
rankings.summaryText: It ain't much consolation, but it's something: Hawks' single-season NBA record for defense (83.4 ppg allowed) looks safe, even with Pistons (84.6) and Spurs (84.9) challenging.

rankings.summaryHtml: On a dreadful 2-16 run, Clips have secured their 11th consecutive losing season. To go with the 12-season drought from 1979-91.
rankings.summaryText: On a dreadful 2-16 run, Clips have secured their 11th consecutive losing season. To go with the 12-season drought from 1979-91.

rankings.summaryHtml: As Kwame plummets back to Earth, here's some rare good news: Arenas ranks second in the league in triple-doubles this season, with three to J-Kidd's nine.

rankings.summaryHtml: Lakers are suddenly so hot that even a recent Lakers castoff -- Jannero Pargo -- can score 34 points for Chicago in his third game as a Bull.
